title: RANDOM TRACK
author: hugz202 (AE-analog-four-mods); MKII port: Iced-Cream
description: Hold a track key and press YES: the track is cleared (stock CLEAR TRACK, after a copy is kept) and filled over its length with a random line: trigs on about 62 % of the steps (the first always), notes in KEY NOTE + KEY SCALE (pentatonic minor when KEY SCALE is OFF) around the track's default note, about a quarter of them accented and a sixth slid. Press it again for another. Hold the track key and press LEFT: the track comes back as it was before the last random line, p-locks included. The FX track is left alone. No settings. With scale-lock, every KEY SCALE scale is used; with slide, the slides play the 303 way. Needs core-a4mk2 0.8 (its ev_track_key). Port of AE-analog-four-mods 0011-rand-track (Analog Four MK1).
